intro: We hold a recorded total fee for {{count}} published B.Tech / B.E. colleges in India. This page gathers the top B.Tech / B.E. colleges in India with fees 2026, so you can see what a programme costs before you shortlist it.
The colleges at the top follow our verified 2026 ranking. After them, colleges are ordered by recorded total fee, lowest first.
listLead: The first cards include IIT Delhi, IIT Roorkee, IIT Guwahati, NIT Trichy and IIT Kharagpur, each with a recorded fee on file. Read the branch name on the card, because a low-fee branch is not a substitute for Computer Science at the same campus.
snapshot: Across the {{feeN}} published colleges on this list, the median recorded total fee is {{feeMedian}}. The middle half of colleges sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
A low figure is worth a second look, because some public-college fees look like one-year tuition. Most colleges here are private ({{private}}), with {{public}} public institutes.
Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Madhya Pradesh and Punjab have the most listings. JEE Main is the exam most often linked here.
firstCollegesLead: IIT Delhi’s B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering is ₹2.49 lakh in our records, with a 2024 average package of ₹25 lakh and a highest of ₹200 lakh, which is a historical record for that year, not a promise.
IIT Bombay, IIT Madras, IIT Kanpur, BITS Pilani and IIIT Hyderabad are missing from this fee list because we do not yet hold a total fee for them.
Some later public-college fees, such as ₹15,000 for B.Tech Civil at NIT Hamirpur, should be checked on the official notice.

sections.heading: How to read IIT and NIT fees on this list
paragraphs: IITs and NITs often publish tuition by year or semester, plus hostel and mess charges separately. A card total of two or three lakh rupees may therefore be one academic year, not the complete four-year cost.
NTA’s JEE Main page says admission to NITs, IIITs and other CFTIs also requires at least 75% in Class 12, or a place in the board’s top 20 percentile, with 65% for SC and ST.

compare.heading: How to compare the top B.Tech / B.E. colleges in India with fees 2026
paragraphs: Use this list of top B.Tech / B.E. colleges in India 2026 as a shortlist, then compare the official fee notice, not only the number on the card.
These checks usually matter more than a small gap in the recorded fee:
bullets: Whether the fee is for one year or the full programme, and whether hostel, mess and institute fees are included.
The branch on the card, especially when a lower-fee department is shown ahead of Computer Science.
The entrance route (JEE Advanced for IITs, JEE Main and JoSAA for NITs, or a state CET) and the cut-off for your category.
The latest official placement report for that branch, with the year clearly stated.

faqs.question: How many engineering colleges in India have fees listed here?
faqs.answer: {{count}} published B.Tech / B.E. colleges have a recorded total fee in our records, and colleges without a fee on file are not placed on this list.

faqs.question: What is the typical engineering fee in India in 2026?
faqs.answer: Among the {{feeN}} published colleges here, the median recorded total fee is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half falls between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.

faqs.question: Why are IIT Bombay and IIT Madras missing from this fee list?
faqs.answer: They are well-known campuses in our wider engineering ranking, but we do not hold a total fee for them yet, so they cannot be placed in a fee list.

faqs.question: Are IIT fees on the cards the full four-year cost?
faqs.answer: Not always, because a card such as IIT Delhi CSE at ₹2.49 lakh may be one year rather than the complete programme, so read the official fee notice before you budget.

faqs.question: Are the placement figures guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No, they are the latest placement year in our records for that programme, and they change with every batch, so confirm them in the institute’s official placement report.
